context: Tests the receiving-code-review skill: judge each review comment on its technical merits against the codebase, implement the valid one, push back on the wrong one with a reason, and question the out-of-scope one, without performative agreement. Comment 1 is correct. Comment 2 is wrong: WeakMap keys must be objects, and the URLs are strings. Comment 3 is a feature nothing asked for. An agent without the skill tends to implement all three to please the reviewer.

checklist.name: fixes_valid_comment
checklist.description: countCodes returns 0 for a namespace that was never created, and a node:test test covers that case.

checklist.name: rejects_weakmap_with_reason
checklist.description: The agent does not switch codesByUrl to a WeakMap, and tells the reviewer why: WeakMap keys must be objects and the keys here are URL strings (or an equivalent correct technical reason).

checklist.name: questions_metrics_scope
checklist.description: The agent does not build the metrics command unasked. It raises it as out of scope for this change or asks whether it is needed, rather than implementing it.

checklist.name: verifies_after_fix
checklist.description: The full test suite is run after the fix, with real output, before the agent reports the review as addressed.

checklist.name: no_performative_agreement
checklist.description: The response to the reviewer states what changed and why, without performative agreement such as 'You're absolutely right!', 'Great point!', or thanking the reviewer.
